episodes.synopsis: It was another long, hard day at work for Kuroto Nakano... until he came home to find a demigod fox cooking dinner for him.
episodes.title: I'm going to pamper him to his heart's content!

episodes.synopsis: Senko continues to pamper Nakano with dinner and ear cleanings, but her outbursts are starting to make the neighbor suspicious.
episodes.title: Don't be shy, now!

episodes.synopsis: Nakano and Senko's neighbor finally confronts them! Fortunately she's a fan of Little Yoko, Inari Girl. Later, Senko and Nakano visit the supermarket.
episodes.title: As long as you're happy

episodes.synopsis: Senko tries to help Nakano get up for work on a Sunday, then gets into a bit of a mess with the household appliances.
episodes.title: Why must you work on a day off!?

episodes.synopsis: Shiro does her best to please Nakano, but gets a little more than she bargained for. Later, Senko scrubs Nakano's back for him.
episodes.title: I've got a tail, too, you know?

episodes.synopsis: Shiro drops by to play video games with Nakano. Later, Senko receives a gift from Koenji.
episodes.title: You just want to fluff more

episodes.synopsis: Senko shows Nakano her amazing massage skills. Later, Nakano misses the last train home, but gets some help from Shiro.
episodes.title: You smell like another fox

episodes.synopsis: Shiro takes everyone to the beach for a day of summer fun. While there, Kuroto encounters a mysterious stranger.
episodes.title: I'll make you forget all about it

episodes.synopsis: Senko notices Nakano drooling over gratin on TV, and enlists Koenji and Shiro to help her make some. Later, Nakano gets a haircut!
episodes.title: Is this less embarrassing for you?

episodes.synopsis: A thick layer of fresh snow provides loads of fun for Senko and Nakano. However, the mood changes when the mysterious stranger returns!
episodes.title: It's Nice to Let Your Inner Child Out Now and Then, Isn't It?

episodes.synopsis: Senko's Izakaya welcomes Nakano after a rough day at work. Later, Nakano decides to visit his mother and father.
episodes.title: It's Going to Be a Rough Night

episodes.synopsis: Nakano returns home to find that Senko is not there. What will be the outcome of Senko's meeting with Sora?
episodes.title: Still...
